name: invelop-contacts-e2e
description: End-to-end tests for the Invelop Contacts app. The Angular workspace lives in ./web.

scripts.db:update: DOTNET_HOSTBUILDER__RELOADCONFIGONCHANGE=false ASPNETCORE_HOSTBUILDER__RELOADCONFIGONCHANGE=false dotnet tool run dotnet-ef database update --project src/Invelop.Contacts.Infrastructure --startup-project src/Invelop.Contacts.Api
scripts.setup:fresh: npm ci && npm --prefix web ci && dotnet restore Invelop.Contacts.slnx && dotnet tool restore && npm run db:update
scripts.verify:all: npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:ship: npm run verify:all && npm run build:backend:release && npm run publish:backend
scripts.preview: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
